req.title: Delete unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when DELETE targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /tasks/{task_id} must return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. Violations in the previous response: test[4] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC (STC is reserved for positive state-transition coverage), and test[5] had kind=negative but heuristic=BVA (BVA is reserved for boundary kinds). Fix: change test[4] heuristic from STC to NEG, and change test[5] heuristic from BVA to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: Task with id=1 exists in the database (seeded row)
FastAPI app is running in-process with TestClient
actions: Send DELETE /tasks/1 to the in-process TestClient
trace: R-TASK-014: positive path — existing task deleted successfully with 204
tests.executable:
import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r014_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)
db_seed = TestingSessionLocal()
db_seed.add(models.Task(id=1, title="Read chapter 5", description="Signal pulse", completed=True))
db_seed.commit()
db_seed.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete("/tasks/1")
assert r.status_code == 204, f"Expected 204, got {r.status_code}"
assert r.content == b"", f"Expected empty body, got {r.content}"

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine_test)
if os.path.exists("./test_r014_pos.db"):
    os.remove("./test_r014_pos.db")

FastAPI app is running in-process with TestClient
